meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪短篇网文热门趋势，发现风口题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速掌握平台热门题材
copy.tagline_en: Track short story trends and discover viral topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web novels and want to catch trending themes

howto.what: 分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的短篇网文热门数据，输出包含情绪类型、题材热点、篇幅分布、开头模式、结尾偏好等维度的扫榜报告，并给出风口预警和选题建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“短篇什么火”、“知乎故事排行”等关键词，或使用命令“/story-short-scan”、“/短篇扫榜”时触发。

say.text: 短篇什么火？帮我扫一下知乎盐言的热门故事。
say.note: Claude会启动扫榜流程，先确认平台。

say.text: 分析七猫短篇的当前题材趋势。
say.note: 针对指定平台进行深度扫榜。

say.text: 对比知乎和七猫的短篇市场。

howto.what_en: Analyzes hot short story data from platforms like Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, and Dianzhong, outputting a scouting report covering emotion types, genre hotspots, word count distribution, opening patterns, ending preferences, and giving trend warnings and topic suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like 'short story what's hot' or 'Zhihu story ranking', or use commands '/story-short-scan' or '/短篇扫榜'.

say_en.text: What short stories are hot? Scout Zhihu Yanyan for me.
say_en.note: Claude will start the scouting process by asking for the platform.

say_en.text: Analyze current genre trends in Qimao short stories.
say_en.note: Deep scouting for a specific platform.

say_en.text: Compare Zhihu and Qimao short story markets.
